description: S45 T5 (PM7.1): the policy_add preview carries the would-be row's describe sentence (policy.Describe, the one formatter — byte-identical to what policy.get will show after a commit) and the target's CURRENT in-force answer through the same handle policy.inForce reads: what changes, beside what stands today. Every row is {policyID, state, render} with render = InForceAnswer.Render() verbatim (D14); an empty answer is [] — never null, never a shrug. Advisory: the commit door re-derives everything.
